headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.75 (95% CI: 0.4–1.4), indicating no statistically significant association between Vitamin B6 and kidney and renal pelvis cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 87.28%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
